metadataRaw.title: How to Instantly Relieve Nerve Pain in Your Shoulders
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve pinched nerve pain in your shoulders!

In this video, we're going to focus on radicular, or traveling, pain caused by a cervical herniated disc (aka bulging disc). This includes sharp, shooting pains that travel from the neck into the shoulder. 

All of these exercises are easy, effective, and can be done at home. As a bonus, they will not require any special equipment, and you may find they give quick relief -- even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

WATCH NOW and quickly fix nerve pain in your shoulders at home!
